description: Search Openverse (CC/PD), Pixabay and Pexels for images whose license passes the policy. Returns ranked candidates with normalized license info, risk level (people/logos) and a ready-made attribution line. Use short English queries (2-5 concrete nouns) for best results.

avoid_people.description: Drop candidates whose tags mention people/faces/logos

no_attribution_only.description: Only return images that need no attribution (CC0/PD/Pixabay/Pexels)

providers.description: Defaults to every provider with a configured key

query.description: English search query, e.g. 'robot office teamwork'

name: search_images
title: Search license-safe images
